summary: Compare squares: the squared norm of a tensor of product vectors is the product of the squared norms.

steps.claim: Passing to squares of nonnegative reals, ‖W(y) ⊗ W(γ⁻¹y)*‖² = ∑_{i,j} |besselFn(y, i)|²|besselFn(γ⁻¹y, j)|² = (∑_i ∏_v |W_{v,i_v}(y_v)|²)(∑_j ∏_v |W_{v,j_v}((γ⁻¹y)_v)|²); a sum over tuples of products is the product over v of the sums, i.e. ∏_v ‖W_v(y_v)‖² times ∏_v ‖W_v((γ⁻¹y)_v)‖².
steps.lean:
simp [enorm]; norm_cast; simp [← sq_eq_sq₀, PiLp.nnnorm_eq_of_L2, besselKernel, besselFn,
    mul_pow, ← Finset.prod_pow, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.prod_sum, Fintype.sum_mul_sum]
